verdicts.title: Galois and Cartan Cohomology of Real Groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Real forms of a complex reductive group are classified by Galois cohomology H^1(Gamma,G_ad) where G_ad is the adjoint group. Cartan's classification of real forms in terms of maximal compact subgroups can be stated in terms of H^(Z/2Z,G_ad) where the action is by a (holomorphic) Cartan involution. The main result is that for any complex reductive group, possibly disconnected, there is a canonical isomorphism between H^1(Gamma,G) and H^1(Z/2Z,G). verdicts.title: Galois actions on complex braid groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We establish the faithfulness of a geometric action of the absolute Galois group of the rationals that can be defined on the discriminantal variety associated to a finite complex reflection group, and review some possible connections with the profinite Grothendieck-Teichmüller group.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns 'a geometric action of the absolute Galois group' on discriminantal varieties of complex reflection groups, with no mention of CNF formulas, resolution proof width, or bounds on Galois group order. It shares only the vocabulary 'Galois' with the conjecture.
